b16494690.desc:
Experience modern living in the heart of the city with stunning, fully furnished apartments designed to meet your every need. Boasting breathtaking city views, separate living spaces, and fully equipped kitchens, our modern apartments combine comfort and convenience to create the perfect home away from home. 

Benefits and Amenities:
• Housekeeping service: twice a week, no dishes. 
• Utility bills included DEWA, Chiller, Gas and Wi-fi. 
• Maintenance services are both periodic and on demand. 
• Fully equipped kitchen. 
• Covered Parking Space
• Clothes washing machine and semi-dryer. 
• Multi-channel satellite TV. 
• 24-hour concierge and security services. 
• Access to recreation facilities gym, sauna, steam, and two heated outdoor swimming pools. 
• Kid's play area. 
• On-site dining options include restaurants, bars, and a coffee shop. 
Note: The asking rent is in 1 payment. 
Prices may increase as per the payment flexibility

Location Advantages:
• Centrally located
• Adjacent to Metro Station. 
• Easy access to Dubai’s major business hubs and attractions. 
• Proximity to iconic destinations. 
• Close to schools, healthcare facilities, and shopping centers. 

Your perfect long-term stay awaits! Whether you're a business traveler or simply seeking a modern retreat, our apartments are thoughtfully designed to exceed your expectations. 

Please feel free to contact Sunbay Vacation Homes for more details!
